basic_info.description: Lovely 3-bedroom, 2-bath home with a dedicated office and 2-car parking, tucked along a tree-lined street just steps from the USF campus. This sun-filled residence blends classic San Francisco elegance and period details with everyday comfort: think parquet hardwood floors, a formal living room with original fireplace detailing and built-in shelves, and a separate dining room that's perfect for gathering with friends and family. Enjoy a bright eat-in kitchen, dedicated home office on the garden level, and an open-air interior atrium that brings fresh air and light into the heart of the home. Every room glows with natural light, and the floorplan flows with grace and function.    Step outside into a mature garden oasis bursting with fruit-bearing lemon and avocado trees, blooming roses, and space to relax or entertain. There is potential for expansion at the garden level and vertically. Located in a coveted central pocket of the city, you're minutes from Koret Health & Recreation Center (with its Olympic pool), Golden Gate Park, and an array of beloved local neighborhoods with vibrant eateries and shops from Inner Richmond to Cole Valley, Laurel Village, Haight, and Divisadero. This is more than a house, it's a urban retreat in the heart of the city. Also for lease @$7,500/month.
